toolsPreview.name: create_inbox
toolsPreview.description: Create a disposable email inbox that expires in 24 hours. Returns the generated email address, creation time, and expiry.

toolsPreview.name: check_inbox
toolsPreview.description: Check for messages in a disposable inbox. Returns a list of message summaries including sender, subject, and preview.

toolsPreview.name: read_message
toolsPreview.description: Read the full content of a specific email message including sender, recipients, subject, body text, and attachment info.

toolsPreview.name: download_attachment
toolsPreview.description: Download an email attachment. Returns images as base64, text files inline, and binary files as download URLs.
